claim.quote: The analysis disfavors various scenarios, in a wide region of parameter space, that provide a feasible explanation of the signal observed by DAMA, assuming an inelastic interaction, considering that the PICO CF$_{3}$I bubble chamber used iodine as the target material.

name: Search for inelastic dark matter-nucleus scattering with the PICO-60 CF$_{3}$I and C$_{3}$F$_{8}$ bubble chambers

summary.plain: Both PICO-60 fills, the iodine-bearing CF3I and the fluorine-bearing C3F8, were searched for dark matter that scatters inelastically, disfavouring inelastic readings of the DAMA signal.
summary.technical: Search for inelastic dark matter-nucleus scattering with the PICO-60 CF3I run (36.8 kg, 3415 kg-day, thresholds 7-20 keV) and C3F8 runs (52 kg, 1404 and 1167 kg-day) (Phys. Rev. D 108, 062003).

title: Search for inelastic dark matter-nucleus scattering with the PICO-60 CF$_{3}$I and C$_{3}$F$_{8}$ bubble chambers
why_it_matters: The abstract says wide regions of parameter space that could explain the DAMA signal through inelastic interactions are disfavoured.
